Stated Claim / Post Context:
Kicker Justin Tucker, who hasn’t played since 2025 after misconduct allegations, reportedly signs with Chiefs

Justin Tucker, who has been out of football since being released by the Baltimore Ravens in the 2025 offseason following allegations of sexual misconduct, is signing with the Kansas City Chiefs’ practice squad, according to multiple reports.

Actual Article Body:

Trending:

Former Baltimore Ravens kicker Justin Tucker is reportedly back in the NFL.

Tucker, who has been out of football since being released by Baltimore in the 2025 offseason following allegations of sexual misconduct by more than 15 massage therapists and a subsequent 10-week NFL suspension, is signing with the Kansas City Chiefs’ practice squad, according to multiple reports.

The move comes after Chiefs longtime kicker Harrison Butker missed two field goals in a 20-3 loss to the Seattle Seahawks on Sunday night. Tucker, 36, has not appeared in a game since the 2024 season.

At the time of his release, the Ravens called it a football decision and made no mention of the allegations against Tucker.

Tucker has also denied the accusations, though he did not appeal the league’s suspension. He has not been charged with a crime and faces no known civil lawsuits.

The five-time All-Pro and one of the most accurate kickers in NFL history, Tucker has worked out for several teams around the league over the past several months. His final season with the Ravens was also his worst, as he made 73.3% of his field goal attempts.

In January of 2025, The Baltimore Banner first reported that six massage therapists said Tucker exposed his genitals, brushed two of them with his exposed penis and left what was believed to be ejaculate on the massage table following three treatments. More therapists soon came forward as more accusations emerged.

Before this season, Butker had likewise been one of the NFL’s best kickers.

However, he has made just 11 of 16 field goal attempts this season.
